mapper.sql: p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, b.slug AS brand_slug, p.gender, p.name, p.slug, p.short_description, p.status, p.is_featured, p.featured_order, MIN(s.price) AS min_price, MIN(COALESCE(s.sale_price, s.price)) AS min_sale_price, COALESCE(SUM(s.stock), 0)::int AS total_stock, (ARRAY_AGG(pi.file_id ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order ASC) FILTER (WHERE pi.file_id IS NOT NULL))[1] AS primary_file_id, (ARRAY_AGG(f.path ORDER BY pi.is_primary DESC, pi.sort_order ASC) FILTER (WHERE f.path IS NOT NULL))[1] AS primary_image_url, p.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT description_json::text FROM products WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT description_html FROM products WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN skus s ON s.product_id=p.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id=pi.file_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, c.name, b.name, b.slug

SELECT FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id=p.brand_id LEFT JOIN skus s ON s.product_id=p.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN product_images pi ON pi.product_id=p.id LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id=pi.file_id WHERE p.slug=#{slug} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND c.status='ACTIVE' AND (b.id IS NULL OR (b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.deleted_at IS NULL)) GROUP BY p.id, c.name, b.name, b.slug
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE slug=#{slug} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id != #{excludeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET category_id=#{categoryId}, brand_id=#{brandId}, gender=#{gender}, name=#{name}, slug=#{slug}, short_description=#{shortDescription}, description_json=CAST(#{descriptionJson} AS jsonb), description_html=#{descriptionHtml}, status=#{status}, is_featured=#{isFeatured}, featured_order=#{featuredOrder}, updated_by=#{adminId} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE products SET status=#{status}, updated_by=#{adminId} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE products SET deleted_at=now(), updated_by=#{adminId} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT pi.id, pi.product_id, pi.file_id, f.path AS image_url, pi.alt_text, pi.image_type, pi.sort_order, pi.is_primary FROM product_images pi LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id=pi.file_id WHERE pi.product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.created_at ASC

SELECT v.id, v.product_id, v.name, v.color_id, c.name AS color_name, c.color_code, v.image_file_id, f.path AS image_url, v.status, v.sort_order FROM product_variants v JOIN colors c ON c.id=v.color_id LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id=v.image_file_id WHERE v.product_id=#{productId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.sort_order ASC, v.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE product_variants SET deleted_at=now() WHERE product_id=#{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.product_id, v.name, v.color_id, c.name AS color_name, c.color_code, v.image_file_id, f.path AS image_url, v.status, v.sort_order FROM product_variants v JOIN colors c ON c.id=v.color_id LEFT JOIN files f ON f.id=v.image_file_id WHERE v.id=#{id} AND v.product_id=#{productId} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE product_variants SET deleted_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND product_id=#{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.product_id, s.variant_id, s.sku_code, s.size_id, sz.value AS size, s.price, s.sale_price, s.stock, s.status, s.created_at FROM skus s JOIN sizes sz ON sz.id=s.size_id WHERE s.product_id=#{productId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sz.value ASC, s.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE skus SET deleted_at=now() WHERE product_id=#{productId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skus WHERE sku_code=#{skuCode} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id != #{excludeId}
